content.comment_body: Hi, I built a program using function block diagram in [product_name] V8 with 318 function blocks and total memory of 79867 bytes. Simulation worked fine. After installing [product_name] V8.2, I opened and simulated the same program successfully. However, when I try downloading it to [product_name] 8, using [product_name] 8.2, I receive an error: download failed, and the program won't transfer. My memory usage exceeds 30000 bytes, which I know can mix program lines after upload, but I don't understand why the download fails entirely.
Hello [user_name], please avoid posting your problem multiple times. One post is sufficient.

This topic has been closed because the same question was posted twice. The second thread, about downloading a program to [product_name] 8 using [product_name] 8.2, was published in the related conference section.

analysis.insight_summary: The user successfully simulated a large program in [product_name] software, but encountered a failure when attempting to transfer it to [product_name] 8 hardware. The program size surpasses typical memory limits, causing confusion as to why a program that works in simulation cannot be downloaded to the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that if a program runs correctly in simulation using [product_name] software, it should also be transferable to [product_name] 8 hardware, even if the memory usage is high.
